_meta.note: Glory is Act 3. Ascension variants are stored in fields prefixed with the ascension level (e.g. a8_hp, a9_moves). Prefixed move lists are FULL replacement lists, not diffs. In Glory, HP scales at A8; attack damage, hit counts and Strength gains scale at A9. Block is the exception and must be read per-enemy: Axebot (Boot Up) and Magi Knight (Power Shield, Prep) scale Block at A8 — these two therefore carry BOTH a8_moves and a9_moves, and their a9_moves lists already include the A8 Block value. Frog Knight's innate Plating also scales at A8 (15 → 19). Test Subject's innate Enrage scales at A9 (2 → 3). Several values have no ascension scaling at all: Owl Magistrate Peck Assault (4 dmg × 6), Torch Head Amalgam Beam (8 dmg × 3), Test Subject Phase 3 Big Pounce (45 dmg), Mecha Knight Windup (15 Block, 5 Strength), Guardbot Guard (15 Block), The Forgotten Miasma (8 Block, 2 Dexterity), Queen Burn Bright for Me (20 Block), Aeonglass Ebb Block (33), Living Shield Shield Slam (6 dmg), and every flat Strength gain. All numbers are taken from Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Glory, Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Elites, Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Bosses, and (for the two returning constructs) Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Underdocks and Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Overgrowth; where a rendered page disagreed with a module on the ascension level, the module was used.
missing: Slay_the_Spire_2:Punch_Construct — no Glory-specific data entry exists; it debuts in the Underdocks and is reused in Glory's Punch Construct + 2 Cubex Construct encounter. All stats taken from Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Underdocks; recorded here with act 3.

Key collision warning: 'Punch Construct' and 'Cubex Construct' also exist in underdocks.json and overgrowth.json. compendium/__init__.py merges all act files flat with dict.update() in sorted filename order, so glory.json loses to both. Stats agree in all colliding entries (overgrowth.json's Cubex Construct previously carried a fabricated 'Submerge' move and starting Block, corrected 2026-08-11 against Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Overgrowth), so the collisions only affect the 'act' field.

Slay_the_Spire_2:Cubex_Construct — debuts in the Overgrowth; all stats taken from Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Overgrowth (its Encounters field explicitly lists the Glory encounter). Both the module and the rendered page list exactly three moves and Artifact 1 with no starting Block; a 'Submerge / gains 15 Block' move that appears in some third-party summaries (and in this repo's overgrowth.json) is NOT in either source and was omitted.
Owl Magistrate 'Judicial Flight' — the module text is only 'Gains Soar' with no stack amount, and the Soar power text carries no number; no numeric value recorded.
Test Subject (Phase 2) 'Painful Stabs' — the module's StartsWith lists the power with no numeric stack, and the power text is 'Shuffle X Wounds into your Discard Pile...'; X is undocumented.

Test Subject phases are keyed as the Bosses module names them ('Test Subject', 'Test Subject (Phase 2)', 'Test Subject (Phase 3)'). The in-game display name during phases 2 and 3 may simply be 'Test Subject' — a human should confirm before relying on exact-name lookup.

'Knight Gang' exists as a top-level key in Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Elites but is a group container with no BaseHP, AscHP or Intents. It is recorded as the `group` field on Flail Knight, Spectral Knight and Magi Knight rather than as its own entry.

'Doormaker' is still present in Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Bosses with Debut = Glory, but the Glory page's update history states 'Aeonglass replaces the Doormaker boss enemy' and the page's boss list omits it. Excluded from this file as no longer in the roster — a human should confirm.

Torch Head Amalgam is typed Minion and has the Minion power, but it is not summoned — it starts the encounter alongside the Queen (InPartyWith). It therefore has no `summoned_by` field and does not appear in _meta.summons.
Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Elites lists no Encounters or InPartyWith data for Mecha Knight or Soul Nexus, and no Encounters data for Mecha Knight's ascension pairing; nothing was inferred.

Keyword sources: 'Bound' has no standalone page (404) and is absent from Module:Powers/StS2_data/Debuff and /Common — its text was taken from Slay_the_Spire_2:Queen. 'Galvanized' is likewise absent from the Powers modules — its text and the 'damage resolves after the Power and can be blocked' note were taken from Slay_the_Spire_2:Globe_Head.

Rendered pages repeatedly label Glory's damage/Strength scaling as Ascension 8 (Devoted Sculptor Savage, Slimed Berserker Furious Pummeling/Smother, Soul Nexus, The Lost/The Forgotten, Test Subject) while the data modules encode {{Asc|9|...}}. The modules were used throughout.

a9_moves: Puppet Strings — applies 3 Chains of Binding to all players (the first 3 cards drawn each turn are afflicted with Bound; only 1 Bound card can be played per turn, and cards are un-Bound at end of turn)

Queen.pattern: Always opens Puppet Strings → You're Mine. While the Torch Head Amalgam is alive she then repeats Burn Bright for Me every turn. When the Amalgam dies she switches from Burn Bright for Me to Enrage, then loops Off with Your Head → Execution → Enrage. If the Amalgam dies after its turn (for example to Doom) she switches straight to Off with Your Head, skipping that Enrage. If the Amalgam is killed on turn 2 or earlier she does not use Enrage on her first cycle. Notes on Bound: once a Bound card has been played, other Bound cards cannot be played that turn even via effects like Sly or a Duplicator; Bound cards duplicated by effects such as Music Box or Dual Wield are also Bound; transforming a Bound card during battle removes Bound from it; retaining a card makes it lose Bound; a Bound card that is played and then returned to hand still cannot be played again until end of turn.
